s.note: Charlene at the safe house, warning Chris away
s.how: Chargrilled corn with lime mayo, cotija, chilli and coriander. Brush the corn with melted butter and cook in a very hot grill pan, turning, for 10 minutes until charred all over. Mix the mayonnaise with the zest and juice of 1 lime. Brush the hot corn with the lime mayo, roll in crumbled cotija, dust with chilli and scatter with coriander. Serve with lime wedges.

s.note: Fresh shucked oysters on ice with lemon and shallot mignonette
s.how: Finely dice 2 shallots and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar and cracked pepper, then rest 20 minutes. Lay 24 freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with lemon wedges and the mignonette alongside.

m.n: Hanna's three-hour beef and pork ragù
m.note: Beef and pork ragù simmered with red wine and a parmesan rind
m.how: Soften a diced onion, carrot and celery stick in olive oil. Add 400g beef mince and 300g pork mince and brown hard. Pour in 200ml red wine and reduce, then add 2 tins crushed tomatoes, a parmesan rind and 250ml water. Simmer gently for 3 hours, topping up with water. Cook 500g rigatoni, toss through the ragù with a splash of pasta water and grate 60g parmesan over.

w.note: Granny Smith apples and cinnamon baked in a sweet shortcrust
w.how: Toss 1kg sliced Granny Smith apples with 100g caster sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 tbsp flour. Fill a 23cm dish lined with sweet shortcrust, cover with a second sheet, cut vents and bake at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve in wedges with cream and strong drip coffee from 60g ground coffee.

d.n: Face-to-face cold brew with cinnamon cream
d.note: Cold brew steeped 12 hours, topped with brown sugar cinnamon cream
d.how: Stir 100g coarse ground coffee into 1L cold water and leave in the fridge for 12 hours, then strain through a fine sieve lined with paper towel. Whisk 150ml cream with 1 tbsp brown sugar and half a tsp cinnamon until just thickened. Fill four glasses with ice, pour in 200ml cold brew each and spoon the cream over the top.
